justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Vestibular training improves outcomes; IAMT VCC-specific comparison not available.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: IAMT certification; multi-day coursework; moderate cost.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable in vestibular specialty settings; IAMT certification pathway.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Standard vestibular billing; no VCC certification billing premium.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Lower employer recognition than AIB vestibular certifications; growing awareness.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Vestibular patients benefit from any specialized training.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Same vestibular caseload limitations on cash pay.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Emory VCC is the gold-standard brand among vestibular PTs and supports premium positioning.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Among the most respected vestibular credentials; differentiates within the niche.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Long pathway makes it hard to scale across an entire staff, but credential anchors a program.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Limited direct-to-consumer awareness; strong ENT/neurologist recognition.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Emory VCC carries real academic weight in neuro PT circles.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Holders are disproportionately represented in vestibular research output.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Excellent for DPT neuro and vestibular curricula, with strong lab content.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Built directly on the strongest vestibular rehab evidence base.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Frequently preferred in neuro faculty searches when paired with NCS.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Significant time/cost, though academic payoff is real.
